```text
# PR #5088: Patch: deeper card stats, X7, Win rate and Play rate on the Experimental tab's Running and Versions

Closes #5037

Each row of `GET /api/stats/versions` now sends `winRate` and `playRate`, and Running and Versions show them as the Cards tab does. Fmt, clippy on the engine and server, the tests I ran and the web checks are green. The harness's full-workspace clippy and cargo test, its web test pass and the e2e specs have not run. I did not take a "before" screenshot.

## What changed

**Engine and server**
- `play_rate` in `crates/engine/src/wire/stats.rs` is the Cards tab's play-rate logic moved out of the server's `play_rate_of`. That function now calls it, so both tabs share one reading. The Cards tab's output is unchanged.
- `PlayVersionFigures` gets `win_rate` and `play_rate`, computed in `figures_of` from the summed tallies. They are never an average of the versions' rates.
- The Dormant Starship reads its used Created games over the games a seat made one (R3070000).
- Play rate is `None` when the play version was never seen, so it shows "—" and never 0%. A play version wholly before the records gets `None` for both.
- Win rate is not nulled below R654's floor. As on the Cards tab, the client gates it on `hasEnoughGames`.
- The oldest totals do hold the tallies: `CardStats.played` and `drawn_not_played`, and `SeatSummary.opening`, `drawn` and `played`, have no serde default. So the only missing case is "never seen", which is the `None` above.

**Web**
- `PublicPlayVersion` gets optional `winRate` and `playRate`, so a server deployed before them shows "—".
- Win rate is a sortable column right after Adjusted. Below the floor it reads "not enough games".
- Play rate is a sortable column behind the Columns toggle, which now offers it on Running and Versions. It is not floor-gated, as on the Cards tab.
- Both sorts are in the Sort select. The Tokens tab is untouched and still reads them as Adjusted.
- The Grid shows Win rate between Adjusted and Games and no Play rate, as the Cards grid does.

**Spec**
- New R5037000, with `spec/pending/5037.md`. It amends R4675001, R4678001 and R4680000 and §9.11's Experimental paragraph.
- `crates/server/README.md`'s versions row names the two fields.

## Tests

- **Engine, `play_versions.rs`:** four `r5037000_…` tests.
  - A one-version play version equals the Cards tab's figures (`win_rate` and `play_rate` from `by_hand`).
  - A two-version span reads 25% and 2/3, where the mean of the two versions' rates would be 50% and 75%.
  - The Dormant Starship reads 2/3 and 1/3.
  - Never seen reads `None`, and a version before the records reads `None` for both.
- **Server, `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs`:** a new `r5037000_…` test, and the key list and oldest-row nulls updated.
  - Over the same records, core-001's versions row equals the Cards row at `winRate` 0.25 and `playRate` 0.25.
  - core-002 reads `playRate` 0 on both.
  - core-004, held and never seen, reads `null` on the versions row against 0.0 on the Cards row.
  - The Starship reads 0.75.
- **Web, `stats.test.tsx`:** four new `R5037000` tests (both columns and the Grid, the Columns toggle on Running and Versions, both sorts in both directions, "—" from an older server). Three Running tests updated for the new columns.

Runs: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib wire::stats` (103 passed), `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::stats` (84 passed), `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance` (61 passed), `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run` on `stats.test.tsx`, `versions.test.tsx`, `CreatedPanel.test.tsx` and `hallOfFame.test.tsx` (163 passed). `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `patches check`, `catalog check`, `classify --base origin/main --claims` (Internal, so no fragment) and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` all pass. `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/stats apps/web/src/routes apps/web/src/net` printed nothing. `PlayVersionFigures` has no ts-rs derive, so `apps/web/src/wire` is unchanged.

## UI check

I ran the release server with `E2E=1` and the Vite dev server, and drove the page with `ui-walkthrough`. The real server's rows all have zero games. They show the new columns end to end: Win rate "not enough games", Play rate "—". For figures with values I patched `window.fetch` in the page to inject sample ones, so those screenshots show layout only. This was after the change only, because a "before" would need a second checkout and about 20 more minutes of builds. Before, Running had six columns: Card, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Since.
- **1280×720:** the table is 1078 px wide and fits with no scroll. Headers are Card, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted ↓, Win rate, Play rate, Since. The Columns toggle shows Games and Play rate.
- **390×844, Running and Versions:** the page does not scroll sideways (page scroll width 390 = client width 390). The table (768 and 772 px) scrolls inside its wrapper (364 px, `overflow-x: auto`). The page's height equals its client height (780 = 780).
- **Grid at 390:** the labels are Tier, Adjusted, Win rate, Games, Since.
- **Tab row at 390:** the Experimental tab is clipped on the right. I did not change the tab row. The e2e spec scrolls it into view, but I did not check whether the clip existed before.
- **Spec 46:** I could not run it (Cypress is not installed here). I measured the same things it checks: no page overflow, and the tab edges.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Tie order.** Running's input order is the Cards tab's list under the same sort, so rows with no figure keep that order, not a fixed server order. I found this when my first test assumed the server's order. The ruling and the older-server test say so.
- **Grid.** It shows Win rate only, with no Play rate and no win-rate range under Show 95% ranges, because the Cards grid has neither. Rejected: adding a Play rate line to the Grid.
- **Versions test.** `versions.test.tsx` also needed its row cells updated (two more "—" per row), beyond the header line the plan named.
- **Hall of Fame stub.** `serveRunning` in `stats.test.tsx` now answers `/api/stats/hall-of-fame` with a 500, so the toggle test can open that view without the route crashing on `{}`.
- **No fragment.** Nothing plays differently, so I added no `crates/cards/patches/pending/` fragment; `classify` reports Internal.
- **Text report.** `stats report --versions` is unchanged, as the plan said.

I added Win rate and Play rate to the sorts of Running and Versions only. The Decisiveness part (#5033) has not landed on Running. When it does, its column belongs between Adjusted and Win rate.
```
